meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把脑成像原始数据整理成标准结构、转换格式并校验是否合规
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你做脑成像或生物医学研究,要把原始数据整理成规范数据集。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run neuroimaging or biomedical studies and need raw data organized to a standard.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 BIDS 标准帮你处理神经科学和生物医学数据:搭建目录与文件名、写 JSON 元数据、用 PyBIDS 查询已有数据集、校验合规性、把 DICOM 转成 BIDS,并创建派生数据。
howto.when: 当你处理 BIDS 数据集时触发,例如把神经科学或生物医学原始数据整理成目录结构、查询已有数据集、校验是否符合规范等。

say.text: 把这个文件夹整理成符合 BIDS 的结构
say.note: 会按规范搭建目录和文件名

say.text: 校验一下这个 BIDS 数据集是否符合规范
say.note: 会报告校验结果和发现的问题

say.text: 把这些 DICOM 数据转成 BIDS 格式
say.note: 会用 HeuDiConv 等转换工具

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude organizes neuroscience data to the BIDS standard: directories and filenames, JSON sidecars, PyBIDS queries, validation, DICOM-to-BIDS conversion, and derivatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with BIDS datasets, e.g. organizing neuroscience or biomedical raw data, querying an existing dataset, or validating compliance.

say_en.text: Organize this folder into a BIDS-compliant structure
say_en.note: Claude lays out the directory and filenames per spec

say_en.text: Validate this BIDS dataset against the specification
Convert these DICOM files to BIDS format
